summary: Strengthen food program decisions, accountability and delivery. Explore the five-day NGO leadership course and its practical outputs.
lede: Leadership in NGO food and agriculture programs involves guiding food assistance and agricultural livelihoods teams through decisions as field conditions change. For NGO program leads, agriculture managers and food assistance coordinators, this includes clarifying decision rights, reviewing Theory of Change assumptions, interpreting indicators and community feedback, and documenting adaptations for team and donor reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who direct or support NGO food assistance and agricultural livelihoods programs and need to coordinate teams, partners and program decisions.
modules: Adaptive Leadership for NGO Food Programs
Theory of Change for Program Decisions
OECD DAC Criteria for Program Review
prerequisites: Prior experience supporting or managing NGO programs in food assistance, agriculture or livelihoods is expected. Familiarity with basic program-cycle terms, such as activities, outputs and indicators, will help you apply the exercises.
